notes.title: Update #3 Ninja weapon added ''Kunai''
notes.notes:
Kunai:
Destroy your enemies with ''Kunai'' use ''Spacebar'' to throw Kunai.

Kunai kills enemy Ninjas and Wolfs

Game controls: 

mouse left click: = Jump 
keyboard: W = Jump 
keyboard: Throw Kunai = Spacebar 

Gameplay: 
Game design edit and added some new art.

Bugs:
Bugs fixed

What is a Kunai:
The kunai along with the shuriken, is one of the most common ninja tools. It is a black dagger with a handle wrapped in bandages and a small ring attached to the end of it.
